test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: english
question:
**In the given sentence, identify the segment which contains a grammatical error.**

I would like you to listen careful to what I am saying.
solution:
The correct answer is **"to listen careful".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• We will use** "carefully" **in place of "**careful."**
